tasks.title: Hosted Bench passes with measured budgets and bounded temporary test floors
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, Preconditions, Measurement provenance, steps 1-5 including status step 2a, Checks and Completion evidence; Required behavior 3-5; Counterexamples (rounding, median, budget/floor, status normal/fallback and measured SHA); Rollout order; Risks; Acceptance evidence 3-4. Keep R1, derived budget/floor edits, README and R2 together. Before edits or measurements require merged #617 and probe/status children. Use pinned api B and independently bracket other main refs for both runs. Apply all hold rules and the pre-decided bounded status fallback; hold on R2 failure without widening values. Only the two bench files change; no tags, thresholdPct, product, harness, CI or other budget edits.

acceptance.command: gh issue view 617 --repo lorenzh/pulse-meta --json state,body,comments && gh pr view <617-api-pr> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --json mergedAt,mergeCommit && git merge-base --is-ancestor <617-api-merge-sha> origin/main && gh pr view <probe-child-pr> --repo lorenzh/pulse-probe --json mergedAt,mergeCommit && gh pr view <status-child-pr> --repo lorenzh/pulse-status --json mergedAt,mergeCommit
acceptance.expected: Before any file change or R1: #617 is CLOSED, its api PR merged and merge commit an ancestor of current origin/main (exit 0); #585 probe/status PRs are merged into their mains. Confirm the child merges are ancestors of the PRE heads with the compare checks below. If any precondition fails, request needs-input naming it; stop if #617 is still unmerged after probe/status are done. After fan-out a person must link the api child natively blocked by #617; do not rely solely on fan-out dependencies.

acceptance.command: API_B=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-api.git refs/heads/main | cut -f1); gh api "repos/lorenzh/pulse-api/compare/<617-api-merge-sha>...$API_B" --jq .status
acceptance.expected: For each run separately, API_B is a fresh full 40-character api main SHA; independent GitHub compare status is ahead or identical, proving it contains #617. Record API_B and status; dispatch with this b input. The workflow checkout head_sha is not the api B worktree SHA.

acceptance.command: for repo in probe status notify contract kit config; do git ls-remote "https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-$repo.git" refs/heads/main; done
acceptance.expected: Run immediately before each dispatch to record PRE for all six repositories, and immediately after the corresponding run concludes to record POST. Label each SHA by repository and run. Before dispatch, compare probe/status child merge commits to their PRE heads: ahead or identical is required. Validate every PRE/POST pair with the following compare command; record A tags and commits from the run's A log line as well.

acceptance.command: gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-<repo>/compare/<PRE>...<POST> --jq .status && gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-<probe-or-status>/compare/<child-merge-sha>...<PRE> --jq .status && git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-<repo>.git 'refs/tags/<A-tag>' 'refs/tags/<A-tag>^{}'
acceptance.expected: Repeat for both R1/R2 and every applicable repo. PRE=POST or compare status ahead validates the bracket; probe/status child-to-PRE status must be ahead or identical. If a non-api main advances, record the measured B as bracketed between PRE and POST containing PRE, not as an exact SHA inferred from the main log string. Record each A tag's commit (peeled commit for annotated tags). If any main diverges or goes behind, discard and repeat that run once; a second provenance failure requests needs-input.

acceptance.command: gh workflow run bench.yml --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --ref main -f b="$API_B"
acceptance.expected: R1 uses api main's harness and existing budgets, pinned api main B containing #617, default A and no others input. Capture the dispatch run ID/URL, watch it and take POST immediately on completion. It supplies five samples per side in one run; known api/notify test_cpu_s failures and the old status 2.4 s budget failure are measurement evidence, not a harness error. The A/B log lines and independent provenance record establish measured revisions.

acceptance.command: gh run view <R1-run-id> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --log && gh run download <R1-run-id> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --name bench-out --dir <R1-artifact-directory>
acceptance.expected: Read table.json and samples.json from this independent hosted R1. Record medians (3rd smallest of five, not means or medians across runs), samples, verdicts and provenance. With ceil0.1(x)=Math.ceil(x*10-1e-9)/10, hold with numbers if probe B>2.3, notify B>2.5, notify B-A>0.6, ceil0.1(api A*1.3)<api B+0.1, any other gating row fails, provenance fails twice, or a harness error prevents valid measurements. Never raise probe or any unrelated budget. Status test_cpu_s follows step 2a below instead of the obsolete B>2.4 rule.

acceptance.command: node -e 'const fs = require("node:fs"); const rows = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8")); const r = rows.find(r => r.service === "status" && r.metric === "test_cpu_s"); const ceil = x => Math.ceil(x * 10 - 1e-9) / 10; console.log({ A: r.a, B: r.b, delta: r.b-r.a, L: Math.max(r.a*0.1, 0.2)-0.05, budget: ceil(r.a*1.3), fallbackFloor: ceil(r.b-r.a+0.2) });' <R1-artifact-directory>/table.json
acceptance.expected: Apply step 2a from R1: if status B-A <= L and B+0.1 <= ceil0.1(A*1.3), use the normal budget reset with no floor. If B-A > L, use the pre-decided fallback without a new approval: floor=ceil0.1(B-A+0.2), budget=ceil0.1(A*1.3); hold with status samples if floor>0.5, budget>3.2 or B+0.1>budget. Normal path also holds if budget margin is below 0.1 s. Example A=2.42/B=2.60 gives L=0.192 and no floor; A=2.42/B=2.65 gives budget=3.2 and fallback floor=0.5; B=2.75 exceeds the floor bound and holds. State status fallback floor applied at the top of the PR body when used.

acceptance.command: git diff --check && git diff --stat <base-sha> HEAD && git diff <base-sha> HEAD -- bench/budgets.json bench/README.md
acceptance.expected: exit 0; exactly bench/budgets.json and bench/README.md change. notify.test_cpu_s is budget 2.5, unit s, gating true, floor 0.6. api.test_cpu_s budget equals ceil0.1(R1 api A*1.3) and floor equals ceil0.1(R1 api B-R1 api A+0.2), retaining unit s and gating true. The rounded budget is both required value and cap; A=3.76/B=4.66 gives 4.9/1.1, not 6.1. status.test_cpu_s budget equals ceil0.1(R1 status A*1.3), retaining unit s and gating true, with no floor on the normal path and only the bounded step-2a floor on fallback. All other budget entries stay byte-for-byte unchanged and no thresholdPct changes. README under Initial budgets adds Temporary test floors with R1 URL, notify/api A/B medians, formulas/results, accepted growth #588/#594/#605/#607 and #561/#617 against v0.1.0, and release tags as an owner decision. The first api PR after the next v* tag of notify/api removes that repo's floor and resets its budget from new A*1.3 rounded up to 0.1 s. Status budget is documented as a permanent normal reset from R1 A because v0.1.0 exceeds 2.4, with arithmetic; only a fallback status floor is temporary with the same removal rule after the next status tag. Contract/config floor text remains unchanged. Security/scope review confirms no product, dependency, Dockerfile, harness or CI change and no release tags.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full test suite pass with the existing coverage gate.
exit 0; all eight bench/selftest/check-*.ts scripts pass, including check-budgets.
exit 0; existing Compose configuration validates. Hosted R2 runs the full Compose benchmark end to end.

acceptance.command: gh workflow run bench.yml --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --ref <pushed-pr-branch> -f b="$API_B"
acceptance.expected: R2 runs after pushing the two-file change. Repeat all provenance steps with fresh API_B from api main containing #617, fresh PRE/POST and A tag commits; default A and no others input. The workflow uses PR-branch budgets but separately measures pinned api main B. R2 head_sha must equal the branch head containing the new budgets. Concludes success, bench exit 0, every gating row ok, no FAIL row and no harness error; status must also satisfy step 2a's condition for the chosen path. Hold with failing rows/samples on any failure, including kit, without widening values beyond the spec.

acceptance.command: gh run view <R2-run-id> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --json conclusion,url,headSha && gh run view <R2-run-id> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --log && gh run download <R2-run-id> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --name bench-out --dir <R2-artifact-directory> && gh pr checks <pr-number> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api && gh pr view <pr-number> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --json body --jq .body
acceptance.expected: R2 conclusion success, expected branch headSha and passing required PR checks (shared checks, bench-selftest and Docker). PR includes R1/R2 URLs and per-run API_B with its literal B log line and #617 compare status; PRE/POST for all six other repos with compare statuses and child-merge-to-PRE statuses for probe/status; all A tags/commits; R2 head_sha; table of A/B medians/verdicts for every R2 test_cpu_s row; R1 arithmetic for api budget/floor and status budget, normal/fallback decision and fallback arithmetic if used; checks/results and risks. Probe B<=2.3, notify budget/floor 2.5/0.6, other values from independent R1. Note kit's previous B=0.672 against 0.7 and runner variability; no automatic widening after merge. State the post-merge handoff: the person merging verifies the first hosted nightly Bench on api main with #617 merged concludes success and posts its run URL and test_cpu_s A/B medians on #585. This nightly is final feature acceptance after pre-merge R2.
